content.comment_body: Hello, I have four [product_name] devices with firmware version [version_no]. They are networked via Ethernet. I've heard that upgrading from firmware [version_no] to [version_no] is possible to address security concerns. After this update, will I be able to upgrade my devices to [version_no]? If not right now, could it become possible later? Thank you in advance for any guidance.
No, upgrading firmware from [version_no] to [version_no] isn't supported. Updates are only available within the same series of devices.
Thank you. So, just to clarify, are you saying I can't upgrade from [version_no] to [version_no]? Best regards, [user_name]
Yes, that was a typo in my previous reply.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are requesting clarification on firmware upgrade options for their [product_name] devices. The discussion reveals confusion about compatibility between different firmware series and uncertainty regarding future upgrade opportunities, leading to unmet expectations about device enhancements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope for straightforward upgrade paths from their current firmware to upcoming major releases, along with clear and official explanations for upgrade limitations, particularly in relation to critical security updates.
